At the far end of the room, an anonymous figure stands confidently in front of a makeshift studio, gazing out at the camera with a hint of mischief in their eye, their eyebrows slightly raised and their mouth curled into a playful smile as they hold a glossy board with the words "Simplicity plan" emblazoned across it in bold, red letters. The camera lingers on the scene, taking in the vibrant colours of the palette - the deep reds and emerald greens of the holiday decorations, the warm gold of the studio lights - before panning out to reveal the entire workshop in all its chaotic, joyful glory. Candid editorial news photograph with natural film-like colour and subtle grain. No text, no logos, no watermark.
